propositions: The DC harness errored all 62 cells at fixture setup due to an ordering deadlock where the session-start field-readiness gate waited for Epic Link and Epic Name fields that are only provisioned by GreenHopper when the first Jira Software project is created.

GreenHopper provisions Epic Link/Epic Name conditionally upon Software project creation, not at plugin startup, making the fields unavailable until after the action that the readiness gate was blocking.

Experiment 30981084637 proved the deadlock by showing that 180 seconds of idle time produced no change in field inventory (27 fields, 0 customfield_*) but creating a project produced Epic fields within 0.0512 seconds.

The original diagnosis blamed insufficient budget, but runs 30975323866 (600s) and 30978613228 (1800s) failed with byte-identical field inventories, with the container idle ~29 minutes after startup completion, proving the defect was ordering not timing.

The fix relocates the Epic-field readiness check from session start (before projects exist) to _assert_project_capabilities (after project creation) and reduces the budget from 600s to 120s (sized to 0.0512s measurement with 2400x headroom).
The jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py probe exhibited the same deadlock pattern with _await_named_fields running before project creation, requiring the same ordering correction.
